title: Hanasato Minori — Look What Else They Have!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, we're all here!
Let's begin today's planning meeting, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You sure sound excited, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because Airi and I did a ton of research just for today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I take it you two also did a fair bit of research?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We did. It only seems right to try to answer this person's question as best we can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we found quite a few fun White Day gifts at affordable prices.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, so did we.
Right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Some were so good that I'm seriously starting to think about getting them myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you two start us off?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
A-Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We'll start by presenting... This!
Shiny candy jewels!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, they're beautiful...!
These are really candy?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! And they make great, little gifts because they're individually wrapped.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, they're all based on birthstones, which means you can tie your gift to a person's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea that they made candy like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me neither. And they look so real.
Who wouldn't enjoy receiving these?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they look amazing.
But they also came up with a great tagline for these. “The gift of everlasting brilliance.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's so wonderful.
But it's a shame that they need to be eaten...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, you two are up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, just give us one second.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We found...this!
A make-your-own chocolate fortune teller!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
This looks just like one of those omikuji boxes you see at shrines...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's exactly what it is, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, this one is different because you get to make your own fortunes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Your own?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, you can have it produce only great blessings, or make ones that say, “Your luck will increase if you talk to me.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. That'd be a nice way to break the ice with someone you don't talk to normally.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Imagine how fun it'd be to have a friend draw a fortune from this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They get a nice gift and have it presented to them in a fun way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Alright, we're off to a nice start.
Let's keep showing each other what we found.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see what else you two found, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Likewise. I'm looking forward to seeing what else you and Airi found.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Then, let's show that thing next!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We didn't actually buy it, but we found a really big piece of candy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
We couldn't help but take a picture because it was so big.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was that big? Can we see it, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, one sec.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, this is what we found...!
A huge lollipop!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whoa, it's so big...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Bigger than a person's face...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! It was huge!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And there are apparently a few different ways to eat it! One is to break it into individual rings!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can also break it into pieces with a group of friends using mallets like you do for a barrel of sake.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Breaking it into pieces seems a bit of a shame, but doing it with friends does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd be so memorable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I'm sure OneMillionFriends actually has a lot of friends in real life.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They'll get to look back on this White Day and reminisce about what they did for the rest of their lives!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Especially since you and your friends from school can be in the same class one year and completely scattered the next.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like this is a good way to approach this topic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we can analyze and draw conclusions after we've presented our results.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good point.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Haruka, Shizuku, back to you two!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Next, this other thing we found...
